snippet.title: FNF Erect Mode Sampler
snippet.description:
For the fans who've been patient, a good taste before the main course: https://kawaisprite.bandcamp.com/album/erect-sampler


A taste of what's in store for the all new ERECT difficulty. Every song so far, new remix. And for all songs to come? Yeah, you get the picture.


And after all the ages, an official FNF twitter to share progress:
https://twitter.com/FNF_Developers

Lastly

All existing current merch on NeedleJuice's website!
https://needlejuicerecords.com/pages/friday-night-funkin


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
